name: interview_debrief
description: Synthesize all interview scorecards for a candidate into a structured debrief with panel-alignment, interviewer-calibration, and signal-gap analysis to prepare a hiring-team discussion. Also supports an unranked side-by-side evidence view of candidates for an open requisition. Decision support only: it never makes or recommends a hire / no-hire decision and never ranks candidates. Triggers: debrief for [candidate], debrief application [id], compare candidates for [req], side-by-side for [req], candidate debrief. Do NOT use for: offer or compensation justification (use offer_builder), recruiting pipeline reporting (use good_morning_recruiting), or writing job descriptions (use job_description_builder).
